findings.evidence: Call me Ishmael... driving off the spleen... I go as a simple sailor... whaling voyage
findings.note: Ishmael's melancholy, going to sea to cure his spleen are present; Queequeg, Spouter-Inn, Father Mapple, and signing aboard the Pequod are not covered in the abridgment
No mention of Peleg, Bildad, or the prophet Elijah warning of doom as the ship sails
No mention of Ahab appearing, nailing a doubloon, or binding the crew to hunt Moby Dick
No mention of Fedallah, the stowaway crew, Starbuck, Stubb, Flask, or Ahab's monomania

findings.evidence: Ishmael's meditations on the terror of whiteness; 'The Whiteness of the Whale' chapter addresses Ishmael's reflections on chance, necessity, and the horror of whiteness; cetology chapter covers whale lore
findings.note: The gams with the Albatross and Town-Ho's tale are not present, but the meditative/essayistic elements are substantially represented
No mention of Stubb's whale chases, the whale-line, the bloody flurry, Fleece preaching to the sharks
No mention of the monkey-rope, sharks and spades, cutting in blubber, Queequeg saving Tashtego, or the whale heads
No mention of Ahab brooding over the Sphinx-like head, the Jeroboam, Gabriel, the Jungfrau, or the Sunda chase
No mention of Fast-Fish and Loose-Fish, Stubb and the Rose-Bud, or Pip going mad
No mention of the try-works, squeezing spermaceti, the blacksmith, the special harpoon tempered in blood, or the typhoon
No mention of Ahab smashing his quadrant, reversing compasses, Fedallah's prophecies, the hawk stealing his hat, or refusing the Rachel
No mention of brit, the giant squid, or Moby Dick breaching and Ahab giving chase
No mention of the three-day chase, smashed boats, Fedallah's dragged corpse, or the Pequod's bows being battered
No mention of Ahab's last iron, the line snaking round his neck, or his being dragged to the deep
No mention of the Pequod foundering, Tashtego nailing the flag, Ishmael surviving on Queequeg's coffin-lifebuoy, or the Rachel rescuing him
